2125344100144599291.en_summary: $MSTR When you make an awful decision to leverage up your balance sheet where the asset produces absolutely zero income and never will AND you use preferreds that pay 12% the inevitable consequence is your equity erodes. The company is now selling equity to buy more NON yielding assets AND buy back the mistake of issuing high yield preferred. Today I believe the MNAV discounted calculated accurately is at a multi year low solidly below 1.0. The good news is the common is now "cheap" to $IBIT. The bad news is the leverage costs will continue to erode the common MNAV and buying back of preferred and adding to BTC will further dilute existing shareholders. Absolute text book failed business model.
2125344100144599291.zh_summary: $MSTR 當你做出糟糕的決定，用資產絕對零收入且永遠不會產生收入的方式槓桿化資產負債表，並且使用支付12%的優先股，不可避免的後果是你的股權被侵蝕。公司現在賣出股權以購買更多非收益資產並回購發行高收益優先股的錯誤。今天我相信準確計算的折價MNAV處於多年低點，穩固低於1.0。好消息是普通股現在相對$IBIT「便宜」。壞消息是槓桿成本將繼續侵蝕普通股MNAV，回購優先股並增加BTC將進一步稀釋現有股東。絕對教科書式的失敗商業模式。
